title: Empty state
description: What a screen says when there is nothing in it yet: one icon, one line, one way forward.
usage: For first-run and no-results states. Name what is missing, then give the single action that fixes it. Never a dead end, never a joke at the user's expense.
a11y: The heading inside is a real heading at the right level for the page. The action is a real button or link.
